verdict.rationale: Rev AI is API-first. The docs expose its core transcription capabilities through the API: async jobs, streaming over WebSocket/RTMP, custom vocabulary, disfluency removal, profanity filtering, timestamps and diarization. One doc shows a dashboard action (file upload) with a matching API parameter (source_config). However, nothing states that the API matches the UI feature for feature. HIPAA processing must be activated at account level, with no documented API path, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of account and dashboard settings, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: File uploads via the Rev AI dashboard or using the source_config job parameter have a file size limit of 5 TB.
This tutorial uses the Asynchronous Speech to Text API to produce a transcript of an audio file submitted by you.
There are two ways to interact with the Streaming Speech-to-Text API: WebSocket protocol, RTMP streams
